purpose: Show why discounted occupancy depends on the initial state and differs from an invariant distribution.
data_kind: deterministic analytic teaching example; no experiment or random sampling

analytic_parameters.sampling: 1000 equally spaced gamma points from 0 to 0.999; open endpoint at gamma=1 is a limit only
analytic_parameters.note: The state distribution alternates and does not converge from this initial state, although an invariant distribution exists.
